subject: Quick sync: AuroraTech demo timing — field-tour impact
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@auroratech.com>, Miguel Torres <miguel.torres@auroratech.com>
Date: 2025-07-01T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Quick sync: AuroraTech demo timing — field-tour impact

Hi Alyssa / Miguel —

Thanks again for the intro call earlier. Per our conversation I penciled a short 30-minute demo for Tuesday, July 15 at 10:00am PT to walk through:

- Redwood's serving runtime and how it affects latency for short chat sessions
- Cost levers (batching, quantization, caching) with rough unit economics examples
- A 10-minute Q&A on integration considerations (VPC/private option)

Attached is a 1‑page demo brief so your engineering/product folks know what to expect. If that time doesn't work, happy to move — please propose 2 alternatives.

Thanks,

Tessa Morgan
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
T: (415) 555-0187
Attachments: auroratech-demo-brief.pdf

From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@auroratech.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-07-07T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick sync: AuroraTech demo timing — field-tour impact

Thanks, Tessa —

Appreciate the brief. Unfortunately we need to push the demo out for now. Two things happened internally: our field-sales team is running a product launch roadshow the week of July 14–25 and engineering resources are tied up finishing the release candidate for that campaign. As a result we can't give the demo the attention it needs.

A few quick asks:
- Can you move us to a waitlist and check back in 6 weeks?
- If it's helpful, send a 15‑minute pre-demo checklist we can circulate to product/eng so they have context ahead of a future session.

Sorry for the short notice — we'd still like to evaluate Redwood, just not this month.

Best,
Alyssa Chen
Head of Product Partnerships, AuroraTech

Totally understand and thanks for the heads up. We'll move AuroraTech to our nurture/waitlist and set a 6‑week check-in.

Quick follow-ups from our side:
- I'll send a 15‑minute pre-demo checklist by EOD today you can share with product/eng.
- If helpful, we can also record a short 12‑minute tech overview your team can watch on their own time (no live Q&A) — would you prefer that in the interim?
- I'll mark the opportunity as "waitlist — field tour" in HubSpot (link below) so Ben can keep an eye on timing.

Proposed next steps:
1) I will send the checklist + a link to the recording (if you want it).
2) We will set a reminder for Aug 19 to re-open scheduling.

Thanks again — we'll stay flexible.

Best,

Subject: AuroraTech — demo moved to waitlist (field tour)

Ben / Priyom —

Heads up: AuroraTech has asked to defer the July demo due to a field-sales launch tour and engineering bandwidth constraints. I moved the event off the calendar and confirmed we'll check back in 6 weeks (target: Aug 19).

What I documented in HubSpot:
- Status: Waitlist (reason: field-sales product tour; eng RC blocking)
- Next touch: 2025-08-19 (Tessa to reach out)
- Assets shared: 1-page demo brief (attached) + offering to send a short recorded tech overview if they want interim context

Recommendation: treat this as a deliberate nurture — high potential but timing-driven. Suggested playbook:
- Priyom: schedule an automated nurture sequence (emails + 1‑pager) starting week of Aug 12.
- Ben: once we see product-tour wrap signals (press or new launch notes), we can request a 15‑minute pre-demo sync to get eng aligned.

I'll upload the checklist/recording link and add the HubSpot link (HS-7890). Let me know if you want me to re-open earlier.

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
